claim: Every law on three values that composes like cycles is rigid on the substrates tested. All 531441 Mal'tsev operations on three values give laws that compose like cycles (BEYOND-TWO B); the 1020 non-simple ones fall into 185 classes up to relabelling. For every class: (1) every three-place knot (all subuniverses of A^3, enumerated exhaustively) is pulled back from a two-element abelian section of its ranges, and every such pull-back is a knot; (2) random systems of three-place knots on the 73 connected cubic substrates with at most 8 points rarely fail globally (a variable confined to a two-element block shortens the parity of a line that reads its top bit), and every global failure found is rigid: after any line is removed only ties remain; (3) on random 4-regular substrates with 5 to 8 points, with four-place knots pulled back from two-element sections, every global failure found is rigid. The same holds for Z3 and for 300 sampled classes of simple three-value laws (sections of two or three elements). Every abelian section here has one layer; ticket C proves that this forces rigidity.
